initial_source_and_workflow_plan.purpose: Second-round real non-image participant metadata application and joined workflow demonstration, independent of the original 453-assertion run.
initial_source_and_workflow_plan.official_license: CC BY 4.0 as stated by the current UCI primary record; preserve original archive notices separately.
initial_source_and_workflow_plan.input_scope: Original subject_train, subject_test, y_train, y_test and activity labels only; original window row positions identify members. No sensor vectors or 561-dimensional feature values are extracted, used for modelling or redistributed.
unit_oracles: Parallel subject/activity vectors must have equal row counts and integer values within original identifier ranges.
Identify official training/test subject sets from actual supplied metadata; verify zero intersection independently with Python sets and a pandas subject/split crosstab.
Every official window appears exactly once; original subject and activity annotations remain unchanged.
initial_source_and_workflow_plan.constructed_split: Actual sklearn ShuffleSplit applied only to original training windows with test_size=0.30 and random_state=72007. This is our fault example, not the official protocol or untouched scientific validation.
joined_workflow: Original metadata to collection/sample manifest with subject identity group and official split.
Official unspecified and group-disjoint protocol states.
Declare fitting/selection members restricted to official training rows; declarations are not external verification of runtime training.
Draw the official training row-count budget using image-uniform without replacement and group-uniform with replacement, recording both settings.
Choose one constant activity prediction by the largest official-training activity count; break ties by smallest activity ID. Do not use test labels for choosing the prediction rule.
Join fixed test predictions to the official manifest and evaluate metrics with subject-unit bootstrap, stratify=false because each subject can contain multiple activities.
Fault probe: remove the split from an original-training row declared in a label-using transform; expect missing evidence UNKNOWN.
Constructed original-training window ShuffleSplit shares participants under a disjoint requirement; expect group FAIL. Restore original official subject membership and re-audit group PASS.
initial_source_and_workflow_plan.execution_gate: Prepare metadata/oracles now. Do not run EpisodeAudit until root supplies the corrected runtime freeze. Record exact runtime module hashes with second-round results.
limitations: Not a new independent laboratory, prospective user adoption study, field plant cohort or unified pathology review.
No sensor classification research, model comparison, algorithmic superiority or clinical-validity claim.
The constant-baseline six-class BA oracle is 1/6; this illustrates metric linkage, not a novel classifier result.
Subject identifiers are supplied by the original data collectors; authors do not independently re-identify participants.
Raw-content hashing and unobserved historical execution remain UNKNOWN.

exploratory_postrun_controls.timing: Exploratory controls planned after the initial genuine HAR workflow results were available; not retrospective preregistration.
